### Codex - 2026-06-27 / CR128 background startup probe repair

Status: CR128 background-first startup repair patched; source guard/compile passed; fresh runtime pending.

- User feedback:
  - The previous CR direction was wrong for multi-window startup.
  - Validated Alt+5/Alt+6 behavior is background HWND shortcut + background screenshot confirmation,
    so five windows can do this concurrently.
  - 五环 still must run every startup guard: Alt+1 map options, Alt+U expand/flying, Alt+5, and Alt+6.
  - These checks must be background-first and concurrent-friendly, not foreground per-window checking.
  - Foreground click correction is allowed only when a background probe clearly detects a wrong option.
  - If a 五环 queue is configured for two rounds, startup UI checks run once for that accepted queue,
    not once per round.
  - Left-top status / map / flying / minimap option checks must first be background-probed and stored
    as pending; only when that window later owns a safe foreground/input turn should it click
    immediately.
- Baseline before this repair:
  - Current branch: `codex/migrate-runner-dialog`.
  - Current HEAD: `2a97dd4309f4b14742cfcb741798d82d64fc230c`.
  - Upstream: `origin/codex/migrate-runner-dialog` =
    `3f0a2e79007121c98a15ad90d5ed7b8902033068`.
  - `git status --short --branch` is heavily dirty before this work. This repair must not revert
    unrelated local edits.
- Evidence found:
  - `DefaultWindowTaskStartupInitializer.beforeTask(...)` applied `LeftTopStatusSwitchService` before
    task-specific startup branching; because `LeftTopStatusSwitchService.isSupportedTaskCode(...)`
    includes `wuhuan_v2`, 五环 leader startup could detect and click immediately.
  - With `bot.dhxy.task-startup-preparation-enabled=true`, the 五环 branch called
    `TaskStartupWindowPreparationService.prepareTaskStartupWindow()`.
  - `prepareTaskStartupWindow()` uses `InputSequences.submitExclusiveAndWait(...)` and direct
    foreground input to open/check/click Alt+1 map options and Alt+U expand/flying state before
    finally calling the background Alt+5/Alt+6 visibility method.
  - `GameClientTracker.captureToFile/captureToMemory` are HWND-first for screenshots, so the capture
    provider is not the core bug. The bug is putting click-needed startup checks in foreground
    per-window initialization.
  - The old CR107 card is historical and remains about 修罗/五倍. The latest 五环 requirement is now
    tracked separately by CR128.
- Source repair:
  - 五环 startup now calls `prepareTaskStartupWindowBackgroundFirst()` instead of directly calling the
    foreground `prepareTaskStartupWindow()`.
  - `prepareTaskStartupWindowBackgroundFirst()` uses background HWND Alt+1 / Alt+U plus screenshot
    probes for map options and expand/flying state. If everything is already correct, it closes the
    panels in the background and continues to background Alt+5 / Alt+6 visibility checks.
  - Only when a background probe sees an unchecked/checked state that needs a real checkbox click does
    it fall back to the old foreground `prepareTaskStartupWindow()` correction transaction.
  - Alt+U is now enabled for background HWND startup probing.
  - 五环 left-top startup now uses the no-click background probe/pending path instead of immediate
    leader startup click.
  - `WindowRuntimeContext` now keeps a queue-scoped startup-preparation marker. `WindowTaskRunner`
    clears it at task queue start; 五环 marks it after the first startup-prep attempt so a two-round
    queue does not repeat startup UI checks on the second round.

  - Added CR128 for the latest architecture repair: background probe + per-window pending consume for
    left-top/map/flying/minimap startup UI guards.

### Codex - 2026-06-27 / CR123 remote case upload design

Status: Worker/R2 upload slice implemented; local contract passed with patched CR124 JSON; Java uploader and real Cloudflare/R2 validation pending.

- User goal:
  - When another user runs DHXY locally and hits a failed/very slow task round, the local app should
    preserve a small diagnostic case and upload it so the maintainer can analyze the problem without
    receiving the full `logs/dhxy-console.log`.
  - First version should upload structured `case.json`, not a zip. Screenshots/marked images are
    deferred to an optional attachment mechanism.
- Existing Cloudflare context:
  - `D:/mavenProject/dhxy-license-worker` is a Cloudflare Worker project, but it is Worker + D1 for
    license verification, not R2 object storage.
  - Its `wrangler.toml` only binds `[[d1_databases]] binding = "DB"` and has no `[[r2_buckets]]`.
  - DHXY already calls `https://dhxy-license-worker.yueyunfe.workers.dev` for `/api/license/*`.
- Design decision recorded:
  - Create a separate sibling project, proposed path `D:/mavenProject/dhxy-case-worker`.
  - Use Cloudflare Worker as the authenticated upload gateway and R2 as the case object store.
  - Do not put large diagnostic JSON/log bodies into the existing license D1 database.
  - Do not embed R2 credentials in the Java client.
- Created/updated docs:
  - `docs/PACKAGE_ARCHITECTURE.md`: added CR123 sprint row.
  - `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-06-27-remote-case-upload-design.md`: first design spec.
- Implementation:
  - Created sibling Worker project `D:/mavenProject/dhxy-case-worker`.
  - Added `POST /api/case/upload` in `src/index.js`.
  - The Worker validates:
    - upload token from `Authorization: Bearer <token>` or `X-Case-Upload-Token`;
    - payload byte size using `MAX_CASE_BYTES`, defaulting to 2MB;
    - required case schema fields: `schemaVersion`, `caseId`, `createdAt`, `caseType`,
      `severity`, and task type from either `taskType` or `task.taskCode`;
    - license identifier from `licenseId`, `license.licenseId`, `license.id`, or
      `app.licenseId`.
  - The Worker stores valid case JSON in R2 under
    `cases/YYYY-MM-DD/<machineHash>/<taskCode>/<caseId>.case.json`.
  - It updates a lightweight date index at `indexes/YYYY-MM-DD.json`, with upsert semantics by
    `caseId`.
  - It supports the CR124 nested local-case shape, especially `task.taskCode`,
    `app.licenseId`, and `runtimeSnapshots.environment.machineHash`.
  - Added `wrangler.toml`, `package.json`, Node built-in tests, and `README.md`.
- Verification:
  - RED: `npm test` initially failed because `src/index.js` did not exist.
  - GREEN: `npm test` passed in `D:/mavenProject/dhxy-case-worker` with 5 tests:

    accept-task flow.

    transaction execution, records it as `phase exception: <ClassName>`, and reuses the existing
    phase-failure/reaccept recovery path.

    swallowed; they still leave the task through the designed stop/fatal path.

### Codex worker - 2026-06-26 / CR120 common-box 业务角色不再读取 runtime role

Status: Implemented; compile / test-compile / focused CR120 guards passed; fresh runtime pending.

Runtime blocker addressed:

- Fresh 修罗 runtime showed leader common-box safe hook could skip as `UNKNOWN` after several rounds.
- Root cause: `CommonBoxService` detection / consume used mutable `WindowRuntimeContext.getRole()` through
  `roleFor(window)` as the business truth. During the run this role can drift to `UNKNOWN` even though
  the task-start context still knows the window is the leader.

Implementation:

- `CommonBoxService.roleFor(...)` now derives `LEADER` / `MEMBER` only from
  `TaskExecutionContext.windowRole`.
- Detection / consume / `hasPendingBoxForCurrentWindow(...)` no longer use
  `WindowRuntimeContext.getRole()` to decide whether a common-box business hook may run.
- `WindowRuntimeContext` remains used for window binding validation: window id, hwnd/native binding,
  player identity epoch, and task-run key.
- `CommonBoxBoundaryBehaviorTest` now covers the actual runtime blocker: a pending leader box remains
  visible when runtime role drifts to `UNKNOWN` but task context role is `LEADER`; context role
  `UNKNOWN` still fails closed.
- No DialogService / AutoCombatService CR104 / broadcast logic was touched in this patch.

Status: Implemented; CR116 source guard and compile passed; fresh runtime pending.

- Worktree was already dirty before CR116. `XiuluoTaskV2.java` contained large unrelated local
  migration/CR changes; this entry only records the CR116 wait-budget change.

Context:

- CR116 came from the 修罗 stuck shape around `2026-06-25 12:53-12:59+`: after tracker green click,
  the leader could stay in `WAIT_TRACKER_SHORTCUT_PATHING` for more than six minutes because the
  180s pre-combat watchdog only ran when the phase loop regained control.
- Existing wait specs could pass `timeoutMs=-1` to `WindowReadyEventBus`; accept-time tracker and
  objective background futures also looped on `future.get(250ms)` without a total watchdog budget.

Implementation:

- Added CR116 source guard:
  - `src/test/java/com/bot/dhxy/task/xiuluo/XiuluoPreCombatWatchdogBoundedWaitWiringTest.java`
- In `XiuluoTaskV2.parkAfterYieldIfNeeded(...)`:
  - Compute `boundedTimeoutMs` from the remaining pre-combat watchdog budget.
  - Pass `boundedTimeoutMs` into both pathing-specific and generic `WindowReadyEventBus` waits.
  - If the budget is already exhausted before waiting, return a normal `FAILED` outcome.
  - If the bounded event wait times out and the compensated state has no remaining budget, return a
    normal `FAILED` outcome so the existing `restartRoundAfterPhaseFailure(...)` path reaccepts.
  - Logs now include raw `timeoutMs`, `boundedTimeoutMs`, pause compensation, wait reason, and source.
- Added central helpers in `XiuluoTaskV2`:
  - `remainingPreCombatWatchdogBudgetMs(...)`
  - `boundedPreCombatWaitTimeoutMs(...)`
  - `preCombatWatchdogTimeoutOutcome(...)`
- In `waitForAcceptTrackerPanelResult(...)` and `waitForBackgroundObjectiveResult(...)`:
  - Each 250ms future wait is capped to `min(250ms, remainingBudget)`.
  - If the budget reaches zero, tracker parse returns `TaskTrackerPanelReadResult.empty()` and
    objective parse returns `Optional.empty()`, preserving the existing shortcut fallback/objective
    recovery path.
  - Local pause compensation is applied while waiting so an intentional pause does not burn the
    future-wait budget.

### Codex - 2026-06-26 / 摄妖香状态栏数字模板自学习

Status: Implemented; focused replay guard, compile, and test-compile passed; fresh runtime pending.
Formal CR: CR117 in `docs/PACKAGE_ARCHITECTURE.md`.

Context:

- User asked why the 12:01:04 摄妖香 check read `7` even though the saved washed image clearly
  shows `47`.
- Evidence:
  - Runtime log: `sheyaoxiang green digit OCR matched remainingMinutes=7 ... text='7'`.
  - Saved image:
    `images/temp/hwnd-3F50A4E/sheyaoxiang_status_green_digits.png`.
  - Direct sidecar replay still returned `text="7"` with high confidence.
  - Pixel connected-component analysis of the same washed image found two digit blocks:
    `(12,144)-(42,198)` and `(54,144)-(84,198)`.
- Requirement clarified by user: do not merely block bad OCR; the system should automatically learn
  摄妖香 status digits from OCR when possible, collect `0-9`, and then use templates to read the full
  number.

Implementation:

- Added `SheyaoxiangDigitTemplateReader`.
  - Segments the washed black-on-white 摄妖香 digit image into digit glyphs.
  - Reads complete minute text from learned templates under
    `images/template/status/sheyaoxiang_digits/`.
  - Uses OCR only as a bootstrap label source.
  - If OCR returns a complete digit string whose length matches the segmented glyph count, each
    left-to-right glyph can be learned.
  - If OCR returns one digit, it learns only the glyph whose bounding box is actually covered by the
    OCR word box.
  - Once `0.png` through `9.png` exist in the template directory, learning stops.
- `PlayerStateService.readSheyaoxiangRemainingMinutesGreen(...)` now:
  - writes the existing washed image as before;
  - runs local OCR as before;
  - calls the template reader to recognize or learn;
  - trusts template/complete OCR results for `remainingMinutes`;
  - treats multi-glyph + partial OCR as `green-digits-learning=N` instead of using the partial value.
- `PlayerStateService.ensureSheYaoXiang(...)` skips refill when the buff icon exists and the only
  missing piece is a multi-digit value still being learned. This prevents the observed `47 -> 7`
  partial OCR from triggering an unnecessary refill.

  `currentSequence()` after combat checking.

  because that branch intentionally waits for the next future combat-state change after rejecting a

  mini-map label matches the expected target.

### Codex - 2026-06-25 / CR104 Xiuluo WAIT_COMBAT maintenance wake

Status: Review / source guards, compile, and test-compile passed; fresh runtime pending.

Baseline / safety:

- Branch: `codex/migrate-runner-dialog`.
- Current HEAD: `2a97dd4309f4b14742cfcb741798d82d64fc230c`.
- Latest pushed baseline checked in this session: `origin/codex/migrate-runner-dialog` =
  `3f0a2e79007121c98a15ad90d5ed7b8902033068`; `origin/dev` =
  `e543d024bf900853944b36d27d0f736005d9eeb9`.
- `git status --short --branch` was already very dirty before this work. This pass is scoped to
  `AutoCombatService`, `XiuluoTaskV2`, `UICleanerService`, focused source guards, and this
  CR board/active-work documentation.
- No OCR/template/click-coordinate/navigation decision is being changed. The existing combat-entry
  maintenance delay remains `4000ms`.

Evidence / root cause:

- Fresh 2026-06-25 修罗 leader `hwnd-6090994` / `刑部ㄨ忍（ID：67555）` showed combat-entry
  maintenance was scheduled but often never ran.
- `14:17:47.747` battle 34 entered combat and scheduled entry maintenance after `4000ms`; 修罗 then
  parked on `WAIT_COMBAT_STATE_CHANGE timeoutMs=-1` and did not wake until combat exit at
  `14:18:22.980`, so the 4s cleanup/panel maintenance was skipped.
- `14:19:40.009` battle 35 scheduled the same 4s maintenance; a later `COMBAT_STATE_CHANGED` event
  happened to wake the task at `14:19:47.956`, then `14:19:48.117` entry maintenance ran and
  `14:19:50.057` clicked the `x2` close button on the correct leader window.
- `14:21:54.938` battle 36 repeated the miss: combat event woke once too early, 修罗 re-parked on
  `timeoutMs=-1`, then no maintenance wake happened before combat exit at `14:23:05.300`.
- Root cause: `COMBAT_STATE_CHANGED` is edge/event driven, not periodic. 修罗 `WAIT_COMBAT` parks
  indefinitely on that event, so `AutoCombatService.pendingCombatEntryMaintenanceAt`,
  40s generic UI cleanup, and configured auto-combat refresh are not real wakeups for the leader
  task unless another combat-state event happens after they become due.

Implementation plan:

- Add a focused guard that 修罗 `WAIT_COMBAT_STATE_CHANGE` must use a bounded maintenance wake timeout
  derived from `AutoCombatService`, rather than the old direct `-1` wait.
- Add `AutoCombatService.nextCombatMaintenanceDelayMs()` for the current bound window. It reports
  the next due combat-entry cleanup, sparse generic UI cleanup, or configured panel refresh.
- Keep the event wait on `COMBAT_STATE_CHANGED`, but bound its timeout so the task wakes near the
  next due maintenance; cap longer waits to a sparse maintenance probe window instead of restoring
  the old 900ms churn.
- Add a focused guard and log for `UICleanerService.findGenericCloseButtonPoint(...)` when no
  generic close button matches, so future runs can distinguish "cleanup did scan but no x button"
  from "cleanup never ran".

Implementation:

- `AutoCombatService.nextCombatMaintenanceDelayMs()` now reports the current bound window's next
  due combat maintenance deadline:
  - pending 4s combat-entry maintenance;
  - sparse 40s generic UI cleanup;
  - configured auto-combat panel refresh.
- `XiuluoTaskV2.waitForCombatStateWake(...)` still waits on `COMBAT_STATE_CHANGED`, but no longer
  parks indefinitely. It uses `combatMaintenanceWakeTimeoutMs()`:
  - near due maintenance: wake at the due delay, with a `500ms` minimum to avoid zero-timeout churn;
  - long/no immediate due maintenance: cap at `10000ms`, so long fights still tick maintenance
    sparsely without restoring the old `900ms` task-turn loop.
- `UICleanerService.findGenericCloseButtonPoint(...)` now logs
  `UI cleanup close button not found` with caller description and `screenPath` when `x1/x2/x3`
  are absent.
- Removed the old unused `WAIT_COMBAT_STATE_CHANGE_TIMEOUT_MS=-1` constant from 修罗 to make the
  new bounded wait obvious.

- UI cleanup:

    `findGenericCloseButtonPoint()` calls `tracker.updateGlobalVision()` and scans close-button
    templates.

    inspect returned `NO_DIALOG`, no generic close button, yet the no-op path took about 8s.
  - User concern is valid: a single stale screenshot cannot safely close stacked/multiple windows.
    The intended card solution is same-pass snapshot reuse only; after any successful map/generic
    window close the frame must be invalidated and a new pass must recapture.
  - User follow-up clarified that a dialog-only click does not need to force a full recapture because
    the small dialog should not cover the map/generic close-button regions; CR102 should avoid that
    unnecessary recapture while still recapturing after real window-layer changes.

  - `NpcClickService` stores `PendingSmartClickEvidence` when `runnerOwnsDialogVerification=true`.

    should therefore not be a 李道宗-only fix.

    phases explicitly call `npcClickService.confirmPendingSmartClick(...)` after consuming the
    expected option, e.g. 修罗 accept/enter-battle and 五倍 accept. Those paths work because each task
    remembered to confirm the pending evidence.
  - User clarified the important boundary: a raw `NpcClickSmart` click is not proof. Direct-click
    evidence should be committed only after the follow-up business option is actually matched or
    consumed, e.g. 医宝宝 matched `heal_pet_option.png`, 修装备 matched
    `repair_equipment_option.png`, or a task accept path matched the accept option. CR103 should
    make that expected-option success boundary consume pending evidence generically, instead of

    `smart-click evidence pending runner confirmation`, then ROI observation recorded, but no matching
    `NPC click attempt recorded`.

    `npc-click|洛阳城|李道宗|324,109|player:*` samples. The 10:55 position `player:321,110` had ROI
    evidence but no direct sample.

Sprint board updates:

- Added CR102: UI cleanup staged snapshot reuse / no-op fast path.
  - Key guard: reuse one fresh frame within a single cleanup pass; recapture after map/generic
    window close, but do not force a full recapture after a dialog-only click unless the dialog action
    actually changes window layering.

    matched or consumed; a bare NPC click without that follow-up proof must stay pending/uncommitted.

Implementation:

- CR102:
  - `UICleanerService.cleanUpAll()` now creates one `CleanupPass` and reuses its current

  - `DialogService` obtains the confirmation service through `ObjectProvider` to avoid a

  - If `clickNpcSmart`'s own expected-template verifier already returns `verified=true`, the direct

Implementation:

- Added `WINDOW_ROUTE_DIALOG_PREPARE_TIMEOUT_MS=2500`.
- Added a per-runner daemon `dialogPreparationExecutor` so route dialog OCR/option preparation cannot
  block the single `window-combat-watch-*` watcher thread indefinitely.

  of synchronously invoking `dialogService.prepareRouteKeywordOption(...)` /
  `prepareRememberedRouteOption(...)`.

  thread so HWND/window-scoped temp paths stay correct.

  logs `route dialog preparation: result=prepare-timeout`, and returns no prepared action. This lets
  the watcher keep ticking and allows 修罗's pre-combat watchdog / recovery timers to run instead of
  silently parking forever.

  identity epoch before actions, but not the submitting task pause token.

  the pause token must be captured at `InputActionQueue` submission time rather than read from the
  worker thread.

  `TaskPauseToken` at request submission time for both action-list and exclusive-callback requests.
- Added a captured `TaskPauseToken` to `InputActionRequest`, with `getPauseToken()` and
  `isPauseRequested()`; cancellation checks now treat a paused captured token as cancel-like.
- `InputActionRequest.cancel(reason)` now stores the first cancellation reason, and
  `InputActionDeadLetter` prints it when no exception exists. Pause abort diagnostics therefore show
  the exact stage, e.g. `reason=task-paused:action-2`, instead of a generic `unknown`.
- Updated `InputActionWorker` to check pause before focus/input transaction, before action-list
  execution, before each action, and before exclusive callbacks. A paused request is completed
  `false`, logged with window id / description / stage, and moved to dead letter without waiting for
  resume.
- Updated `InputActionScope.isCancelled()` so long exclusive/direct-input callbacks that poll the
  scope also stop when the captured request pause token is paused.
- Added `InputActionPauseCancellationGuardTest` to prove queue capture, scope polling, worker stage
  wiring, and a direct behavior case where `MOVE_MOUSE` requests pause and the later
  `SLEEP -> CLICK_LEFT` steps do not run.

### 唐德 - 2026-06-24 / CR95 live window identity drift guard

Status: Review / Jason + Codex heartbeat P1/P2 follow-up and blank-title tracker follow-up repaired; fresh runtime pending.

Baseline / safety:

- Branch: `codex/migrate-runner-dialog`.
- Current HEAD: `2a97dd4309f4b14742cfcb741798d82d64fc230c`.
- Latest pushed baseline checked: `origin/dev` = `e543d024bf900853944b36d27d0f736005d9eeb9`.
- Working tree is already dirty from earlier CR work. CR95 scope is limited to native binding refresh,
  runtime same-HWND identity drift detection, and player-scoped cache invalidation. Do not touch
  OCR/template/click/navigation algorithms for this card.
- Evidence read before edit: `WindowNativeBindingRefreshService.refreshGeometry(...)` only reads
  `GetWindowRect(...)`; `WindowNativeBinding.withGeometry(...)` preserves stale title/class/process;
  `GameClientTracker.useBoundWindowIfAvailable()` only calls `setNativeBinding(...)` when geometry
  changes; `TaskMaintenanceService` keeps 三技能 `skillCount/nextStartIndex/tailSafe` state keyed by
  `windowId/default`; `PlayerStateService` keeps 摄妖香/first-aid state keyed by `windowId/default`.

Plan:

- Add source tests for live title refresh, same-HWND title/player drift, geometry-only refresh, blank
  live title, and lazy invalidation of player-scoped maintenance caches.
- Refresh live title/class/process together with geometry. Blank live titles are carried to runtime
  commit so the currently committed binding, not a stale caller binding, decides preservation.
- Let `WindowRuntimeContext` detect same-HWND player/title drift, update `GameContext.State.me`, clear
  stale dialog/pathing/prepared state, and bump a player-identity epoch.
- Make per-window player caches compare that epoch and reset themselves before reuse.

Implemented:

- `WindowNativeBindingRefreshService.refreshGeometry(...)` now refreshes live title/class/process
  together with geometry through a testable native probe. After Cbank feedback, transient blank live
  titles are no longer folded into a caller-side stale title before runtime commit.
- `WindowRuntimeContext.setNativeBinding(...)` now detects same-HWND player/title drift, updates
  `GameContext.State.me`, clears stale visible dialog / dialog interest / dialog preparation /
  prepared action / pathing / pending route memories, and increments `playerIdentityEpoch`.
- `GameClientTracker`, `MultiWindowTaskManager`, and `TaskWindowRuntimeService` now write each valid
  refreshed binding back to `WindowRuntimeContext`, so same-geometry title drift is observable.
- `TaskMaintenanceService` 三技能 state and `PlayerStateService` player runtime state now compare
  `playerIdentityEpoch` and lazily reset stale per-player window caches before reuse. After Cbank
  feedback, 三技能 resolves epoch-scoped state before reading `lastSummonSkillCleanAtByWindow`, so a
  new player cannot inherit the previous player's 20-minute cooldown.
- `ClientIdentityService` now uses the same `WindowTitleIdentityParser` as the drift guard.
- Cbank P2 follow-up:
  - `InputActionQueue`, `WindowAwareInputCoordinator`, and `BoundWindowKeyboardService` refresh and
    commit the live native binding before pure input/focus/HWND-keyboard actions, so input-only
    paths can observe same-HWND account drift before the next screenshot/tracker refresh.
  - `TeamRoleDetectionService.resolveCurrentPlayerId(...)` now prefers the current runtime binding
    title over the task-start `TaskExecutionContext.nativeWindowTitle`.
  - `AutoCombatService` runtime state now records `playerIdentityEpoch` and resets pending
    combat-entry / follower first-aid pressure when the same window id belongs to a new player.
- Codex re-review P1 follow-up: `WindowRuntimeContext.setNativeBinding(...)` is now synchronized, so
  reading the current binding, preserving transient blank titles, detecting drift, clearing stale
  player-scoped state, incrementing epoch, and assigning the new binding happen in one atomic commit.
- Lagrange/Codex P1 stale-nonblank follow-up: added
  `WindowNativeBindingRefreshService.refreshAndCommit(...)`, which performs live native refresh and
  runtime binding commit inside the same runtime-context monitor. Production runtime paths now use this
  method instead of capturing a live snapshot and committing it later from the caller.
- Lagrange/Codex P1 input-epoch follow-up: `InputActionRequest` now captures request-time
  `playerIdentityEpoch`, and `InputActionWorker` cancels old-epoch queued input before focus,
  before exclusive callbacks, and before each action.
- Jason/Codex continued review follow-up: `BoundWindowKeyboardService.pressShortcut(...)` now captures
  `playerIdentityEpoch` before its internal live refresh and returns `player-identity-epoch-changed`
  without posting Alt keys if that refresh discovers a player drift.
- Jason/Codex P2 follow-up: `ClientIdentityService.resolveCurrentWindowTitle(...)` and
  `TeamRoleDetectionService.resolveCurrentPlayerId(...)` now call `refreshAndCommit(...)` before
  reading the runtime binding title.
- Jason/Codex second continued review follow-up:
  - `BoundWindowKeyboardService.pressShortcut(...)` now returns terminal `ShortcutAttempt` results for
    `player-identity-epoch-changed` and `live-binding-refresh-unavailable`.
  - `InputActionWorker.pressAltShortcut(...)` returns request failure on terminal shortcut rejection and
    skips focused real-input fallback.
  - `NavigationService.pressAlt1ForMiniMap(...)` skips direct `inputProvider.pressAlt1()` fallback on
    terminal shortcut rejection.
  - Background HWND keyboard whitelist is narrowed back to the documented verified set
    `Alt+1/2/4/6/8/T/O/E/Q`; `Alt+A/C/U` still work through the existing focused real-input path but
    no longer use background HWND delivery until separately validated.
- 2026-06-24 blank-title tracker follow-up: `GameClientTracker.useBoundWindowIfAvailable(...)` no longer
  uses `context.getWindowId()` as the tracker title when the committed/live binding title is blank.
  It retains only a previous parseable real game title; otherwise it writes blank so identity parsing
  and downstream logs cannot treat `hwnd-*` as a pseudo window title.

### Codex - 2026-06-22 / CR65 entry-maintenance panel verify root cause fix

Status: Review: source/test/compile passed; fresh runtime pending. 用户批准直接修 CR65。本轮处理 fresh 修罗 runtime 里仍出现的
`auto-combat panel: verify and align` / `auto-combat panel rounds refresh by Alt+8` / team-burst defer 噪声。

Baseline before edit:

- Branch: `codex/migrate-runner-dialog`.
- HEAD: `2a97dd4`.
- `git status --short` was already very dirty before this edit; unrelated Java/docs/config/log/testcase files are left untouched.
- Relevant current CR65 implementation before this edit:
  - `AutoCombatService.maybeRunCombatMaintenance(...)` already has a pre-verify gate for optional `refresh-due` checks.
  - That gate runs only in the optional periodic refresh branch.
  - The combat-entry maintenance branch still calls `autoCombatPanelService.verifyAndAlignPanel(context)` directly.
  - `AutoCombatPanelService.verifyAndAlignPanel(...)` currently combines three concerns: panel visibility, panel alignment, and remaining-round refresh via `refreshAutoCombatRoundsIfNeeded(...)`.

Fresh runtime root cause:

- `docs/run-reports/2026-06-22-xiuluo-run-observation.md` range `18:24:18.886-18:29:48.647` still had
  `verify and align=13`, `Alt+8 rounds refresh=5`, and inner burst defers.
- Cutting each verify line against nearby logs shows the majority were not from the optional refresh branch:
  - e.g. `18:25:57.765`, `18:25:58.163`, `18:25:59.476`, `18:26:01.043`, `18:26:01.162`,
    `18:28:03.929`, `18:28:05.593`, `18:28:05.922`, `18:28:07.629` are
    `auto-combat entry maintenance: clean generic windows and verify panel`.
  - Those entry-maintenance calls then run `verifyAndAlignPanel(...)`, which reaches
    `refreshAutoCombatRoundsIfNeeded("verify", context)` and can still issue `reason=unknown`,
    `reason=refresh-due`, or inner `team burst guard` logs.
- Root cause: entry maintenance uses the same compound verify method as the periodic refresh path,
  so it bypasses the CR65 pre-verify gate and pays the round-refresh work even when this entry tick
  only needed panel visibility/alignment.

Planned scope:

- Split panel verification mode narrowly so entry maintenance can verify/align the panel without
  refreshing remaining rounds.
- Keep periodic optional refresh behavior unchanged: healthy cache skip, refresh-due pre-gate,
  low-rounds / unknown immediate refresh, and existing `Alt+8` behavior all remain in the periodic
  branch.
- Do not change battle radar, dialog fallback, maintenance broadcast matching, click coordinates,
  OCR/template thresholds, WUBEI, 五环, or 修罗 task phase semantics.

TDD:

- Extended `AutoCombatRefreshDuePanelVerifyGateTest` before production edit.
- RED confirmed the entry-maintenance branch still used the old compound panel verify path:
  missing `AutoCombatPanelService.PanelVerifyMode.ENTRY_MAINTENANCE`.
- The test now also guards that entry maintenance does not update `lastAutoBattleRefreshAt` and does
  not call the old `verifyAndAlignPanel(context)` overload.

Implementation:

- `AutoCombatPanelService.verifyAndAlignPanel(...)` now requires an explicit `PanelVerifyMode`.
- `VERIFY_AND_REFRESH` preserves the previous periodic behavior: verify visible panel, align if needed,
  then refresh remaining rounds through the existing low-rounds / unknown / refresh-due policy.
- `ENTRY_MAINTENANCE` verifies/aligns the panel only and logs
  `auto-combat panel rounds refresh skipped: source=entry-maintenance reason=verify-only`; it never
  calls `refreshAutoCombatRoundsIfNeeded(...)`.
- `AutoCombatService` combat-entry maintenance now calls `ENTRY_MAINTENANCE` and no longer updates
  `lastAutoBattleRefreshAt`, because no real `Alt+8` refresh happened in that branch.
- The periodic optional refresh branch now calls `VERIFY_AND_REFRESH`, keeping the previous CR65
  cache/pre-gate/team-burst semantics.

Verification:

- `javac -encoding UTF-8 -cp "target/classes;$cp" -d target/test-classes src\test\java\com\bot\dhxy\service\AutoCombatRefreshDuePanelVerifyGateTest.java` passed after the fix.
- `java -cp "target/test-classes;target/classes;$cp" com.bot.dhxy.service.AutoCombatRefreshDuePanelVerifyGateTest` passed.
- `mvn -q -DskipTests test-compile` passed.
- CR65 related direct tests passed:
  - `AutoCombatRefreshDuePanelVerifyGateTest`
  - `AutoCombatPanelRefreshDueBurstGuardTest`
  - `Cr65NoActionLogPressureWiringTest`
  - `DialogMaintenanceFallbackPolicyTest`
  - `DialogMaintenanceLightweightFallbackPolicyWiringTest`
- `mvn -q -DskipTests compile` passed.

Fresh runtime still needed before Done:

- Entry-maintenance `verify and align` should no longer be followed by `rounds refresh by Alt+8` or
  same-team refresh-due defers.
- Periodic optional refresh must still refresh immediately for `unknown` and `low-rounds`, and must
  keep the existing same-team `refresh-due` gate.

### Codex - 2026-06-22 / CR65 auto-combat panel verify gate follow-up

Status: Review: source/test/compile passed; fresh runtime pending. 用户明确批准继续做 CR65；本轮处理 fresh 修罗报告里仍高频出现的
`auto-combat maintenance: refresh auto combat panel` / `verify and align` / refresh-due defer 噪声。

Baseline before edit:

- Branch: `codex/migrate-runner-dialog`.
- HEAD: `2a97dd4309f4b14742cfcb741798d82d64fc230c`.
- Upstream: `origin/codex/migrate-runner-dialog` at `3f0a2e79007121c98a15ad90d5ed7b8902033068`.
- Worktree was already very dirty before this edit; unrelated Java/docs/config/log/testcase files are left untouched.
- Relevant local CR65 state before this edit:
  - `DialogService` / `AutoBattleTask` already keep auto-battle lightweight maintenance on fixed-strip checks; full dialog fallback stays disabled for that path.
  - `AutoCombatPanelService.TeamRefreshDueBurstGuard` only defers `reason=refresh-due`; `unknown` and `low-rounds` bypass.
  - Prior CR65 follow-up only throttled no-action info logs. It did not prevent `AutoCombatService` from entering heavy panel verify before a refresh-due defer.
- Current code evidence before this edit:
  - `AutoCombatService.maybeRunCombatMaintenance(...)` calls `autoCombatPanelService.verifyAndAlignPanel(context)` whenever `lastAutoBattleRefreshAt` reaches `botProperties.autoBattleRefreshIntervalMs`.
  - `AutoCombatPanelService.verifyAndAlignPanel(...)` logs, screenshots/matches the panel, aligns it, and only then reaches the refresh-due burst guard.
  - Therefore a same-team `refresh-due` defer can still pay the expensive verify/alignment path and produce log pressure.

Planned scope:

- Add a small pre-verification gate for optional `refresh-due` auto-combat panel maintenance so same-team defers can skip the expensive verify path.
- Keep `unknown` and `low-rounds` immediate; do not block entry maintenance, panel-missing recovery, actual Alt+8 refresh, OCR/template thresholds, click/input, maintenance broadcast fallback, WUBEI, 五环, or 修罗 phases.
- Keep a separate per-window verify cooldown/check timestamp; do not treat a skipped check as a real Alt+8 refresh.

TDD:

- Added `AutoCombatRefreshDuePanelVerifyGateTest` first.
- RED confirmed before production edit: missing `AutoCombatPanelService.resolveRoundsRefreshReason(...)`,
  `RoundsRefreshReason`, and `AutoCombatService.RefreshDuePanelVerifyGate`.

Implementation:

- `AutoCombatPanelService` now has one shared `RoundsRefreshReason` classifier for cached round state:
  `UNKNOWN`, `LOW_ROUNDS`, `REFRESH_DUE`, or healthy/no action.
- `AutoCombatService.maybeRunCombatMaintenance(...)` now checks cached round state before heavy panel
  verification. If cached rounds are healthy, it skips the panel verify and only advances the local optional
  check timer.
- Only optional `REFRESH_DUE` checks enter the new same-team `RefreshDuePanelVerifyGate` before
  `verifyAndAlignPanel(...)`. A same-team defer skips screenshot/template/alignment work and records a
  per-window retry timestamp so the next tick does not immediately re-run the same no-action path.
- `UNKNOWN` and `LOW_ROUNDS` bypass this pre-verify gate and still call the existing panel verify/Alt+8
  path immediately.
- Entry maintenance still calls `verifyAndAlignPanel(...)` directly; the gate only applies to periodic
  optional refresh-due checks.

### Codex - 2026-06-22 / CR74 intent-replaced mixed-runtime follow-up

Status: In Progress. 用户要求继续 CR74，先弄清楚为什么部分 world-map route-result memory 已经可用，而部分仍被 `intent-replaced`。

Baseline before edit:

- Branch: `codex/migrate-runner-dialog`.
- HEAD: `2a97dd4 Document world map route result memory design`.
- `git status --short` was already very dirty before this edit; unrelated modified/untracked Java/docs/config/log/testcase files are left untouched.
- Relevant existing guard: `NavigationWorldMapRouteMemoryIntentOwnershipTest` only protected the direct `submitWorldMapSearchAndClickDestination(...) -> PATHING_STARTED` branch.

Fresh runtime evidence:

- Positive examples prove the first CR74 repair partly works:
  - `2026-06-22 13:05:56.585` `[world-map-route-memory] fast path used: fromMap=灵兽村 targetMap=凤巢五层`.
  - `2026-06-22 14:19:05.203` `[world-map-route-memory] fast path used: fromMap=灵兽村 targetMap=白骨山`.
  - Multiple `pending success` lines now reach `clean=true` and later `usedMemory=true`.
- Negative examples still reproduce the remaining bug:
  - `2026-06-22 13:26:40.516` created pending for `灵兽村 -> 洛阳城` with `intentId=0f5aaf9b...`.
  - `2026-06-22 13:26:55.627` registered a second `navigateToMap` intent for the same target with source `same target route already submitted; watcher will confirm pathing`.
  - `2026-06-22 13:27:00.515` abandoned the original pending as `reason=intent-replaced`.
  - Similar replace examples appear for `兰若寺`, `四圣庄`, `万寿山`, `长安`, `蟠桃园`, and later `洛阳城`.

Root cause:

- The first CR74 patch only covered the immediate successful world-map submit branch.
- Remaining replace cases come from later `navigateToMap(...)` re-entry while the same route leg is already active:
  - `pathing-active-gate` returns `PATHING_STARTED` with message `same target route already submitted; watcher will confirm pathing`;
  - `routeDialogGateBeforeWorldMap(...)` returns `PATHING_STARTED` with message `same target route already submitted before world-map search; watcher will confirm pathing`;
  - prepared route-dialog click branches can also return `PATHING_STARTED` while the old active same-target intent still owns the route leg.
- Those branches did not set `pathingIntentAlreadyActive` / `pathingIntentOwnedByNestedRoute`, so the `finally` block still registered an outer duplicate `navigateToMap` intent. `WindowTaskRunner.settlePendingWorldMapRouteResultMemory(...)` then correctly treated the old pending intent id as replaced.

Implementation:

- `NavigationService.navigateToMap(...)` now marks `pathingIntentAlreadyActive` when a same-target active intent already owns a `PATHING_STARTED` result from:
  - prepared route-dialog priority click;
  - fresh same-target route pending in the pathing-active gate;
  - `routeDialogGateBeforeWorldMap(...)` returning `PATHING_STARTED`.
- This keeps the existing `intent-replaced` abandon behavior for a real second navigation, but avoids replacing the same route leg with a duplicate outer intent.
- Extended `NavigationWorldMapRouteMemoryIntentOwnershipTest` so future patches must protect both the direct submit branch and the same-target/gate re-entry branches.

Verification:

- `mvn -q -DskipTests test-compile; java -cp "target/test-classes;target/classes" com.bot.dhxy.service.NavigationWorldMapRouteMemoryIntentOwnershipTest` passed.
- `mvn -q -DskipTests compile` passed.

Fresh runtime still needed:

- Repeated 修罗 route runs should show these same-target re-entry cases no longer produce immediate `intent-replaced`.
- Successful arrivals should keep increasing consecutive success and produce `fast path used`.

### Codex - 2026-06-21 / 修罗 direct-combat 飞行状态 UNKNOWN 调查

Status: investigation only; no Java/OCR/template/click/navigation code changed. User asked why the paused-before round did not try AutoJ/Alt+A after failing to click 修罗.

Evidence from `logs/dhxy-console.log` around `2026-06-21 23:00:29-23:03:04`:
- Round 11 reached target `龙窟七层(49,1)` and entered `CLICK_TARGET_NPC`.
- The normal target click pipeline failed: task tooltip not found, yellow OCR had no candidates, player anchor was null, Ctrl menu origins were empty, and recovered `看打` dialog/template checks returned `NONE`.
- Direct-combat fallback was attempted as a preflight, but every attempt stopped before pressing Alt+A because `GameStateUtil.detectFlyingState(...)` returned `UNKNOWN`.
- Repeated examples: `23:00:39`, `23:00:56`, `23:01:17`, `23:02:18`, `23:02:43`, and `23:02:54` all log `NPC direct-combat preflight flying state ... state=UNKNOWN` followed by `NPC direct-combat skipped because flying state is unknown`.

Current implementation detail:
- `detectFlyingState(...)` presses `Alt+U`, waits `350ms`, then searches only the fixed window-relative rect `(692,521)-(751,549)` for `images/template/status/flying.png` (`降落`) and `images/template/status/unflying.png` (`飞行`) at match rate `0.84`.
- It toggles `Alt+U` closed in `finally`, but it does not save the opened-panel screenshot/crop. The latest `latest_vision.png` is after the panel was closed, so the failure screenshot is not available.
- Correction: the marked `latest_vision` image is not an Alt+U status-panel screenshot; it is a later post-failure navigation/return image and must not be used as evidence for what the opened status panel looked like. It only illustrates the fixed screen region that the current code would inspect.
- Current `latest_vision` marked/cropped for the probe rectangle was saved only as a coordinate reference:
  - `images/temp/hwnd-5270E24/flying_status_probe_latest_marked.png`
  - `images/temp/hwnd-5270E24/flying_status_probe_latest_crop.png`
- User manually opened the real Alt+U status panel and a fresh screenshot was captured without sending keys:
  - `images/temp/hwnd-5270E24/flying_status_manual_altu_full_20260621_231633_681.png`
  - `images/temp/hwnd-5270E24/flying_status_manual_altu_marked_20260621_231633_681.png`
  - `images/temp/hwnd-5270E24/flying_status_manual_altu_crop_20260621_231633_681.png`
  - `images/temp/hwnd-5270E24/flying_status_manual_altu_summary_20260621_231633_681.json`
- The fresh manual Alt+U image proves the fixed rect is wrong for this live layout: it lands on the bottom-right page/arrow button of the flight panel, not on the `飞行` / `降落` button. Template scores are therefore very low (`flying=0.2479`, `unflying=0.1461`, threshold `0.84`), so the current detector will correctly return `UNKNOWN` even when the panel is actually open.

Conclusion:
- This is a CR73 blocker, not a missing fallback call. The code reaches the direct-combat fallback, but the flying-state safety gate treats UNKNOWN as fatal and returns before `npcClick:directCombat:enterAltA`.
- Next code card should make the flying-state probe save debug evidence and recalibrate the inspected rect from the real Alt+U panel. Do not silently bypass UNKNOWN without user approval because CR73 intentionally added it as a global safety boundary before AutoA.

- `DialogService` already has a fast path: `CLICK_REMEMBERED_POINT && !request.isVerifyDialogType()` logs `dialog remembered option fast path without detect` and clicks the remembered relative point using the stable dialog rect.
- `XiuluoTaskV2.acceptTaskDialog(...)` calls `handleKnownXiuluoOptionDialog(..., verifyDialogType=false)`, so the normal accept dialog phase already says the expected OPTION dialog is established.
- `XiuluoTaskV2.tryRememberedAcceptTaskOption(...)` currently discards that caller fact by using `DialogHandleRequest.handleRememberedChoiceOption(...)`, whose default `verifyDialogType=true` forces a full `detectDialogSnapshotDirect(...)` pass.
- Fresh logs show the cost: `xiuluo-v2:accept:*:accept-memory` repeatedly logs `dialog detect no-focus: reason=handle-dialog:CLICK_REMEMBERED_OPTION` with `elapsedMs=883/1169/1808/3136` before `dialog remembered option click ... rel=(95,113)`.
- `NpcClickService.runNpcClickPipeline(...)` currently calls `prepareNpcPipelineNameLayerOnce(...)` before learned memory for non-direct-combat paths, so stable fixed NPC clicks still pay `npcClick:pipeline-hide-player-names:<npc>` / `Alt+4` / `400ms` before the learned point can verify.

Sprint Board update:

- Published CR75: `Use 修罗 remembered accept-option fast path without re-detecting dialog type`.
  - Scope: preserve `verifyDialogType=false` into the修罗 accept-memory request only when the caller already established the accept OPTION dialog.
  - Acceptance: fresh logs show `dialog remembered option fast path without detect` and no `handle-dialog:CLICK_REMEMBERED_OPTION` detect for stable accept-memory hits; miss fallback remains the existing green-template path.
- Published CR76: `Try stable NPC learned-memory click before Alt+4 name-layer preparation`.
  - Scope: keep pre-click dialog safety, then allow stable learned-memory NPC clicks to verify before `Alt+4`; on miss, return to the existing Alt+4 + tooltip/yellow/formula/Ctrl fallback order.
  - Boundary: do not reorder WUBEI/白龙马 `COMBAT_TARGET` tooltip/direct-combat semantics and do not change OCR/template/click-coordinate algorithms.

Performance goal check:

- No runtime improvement yet because this is docs-only publication.
- Expected CR75 win: remove roughly `0.8s-3.1s` full dialog detection before stable accept-memory option clicks.
- Expected CR76 win: remove one `Alt+4 + 400ms sleep` plus input-queue wait before stable learned NPC memory hits.
- These two cards should reduce 修罗 accept-loop latency without touching WAIT_COMBAT, runner 100ms/900ms scanning, CR68 pathing waits, or CR74 route-result memory.

Next action:

- Implement CR75 first because it uses an existing DialogService fast path and has lower blast radius.
- Implement CR76 second with source/wiring guard evidence so WUBEI/白龙马 probe target semantics do not move.

### Codex - 2026-06-21 / CR74 修罗 world-map route-result memory intent ownership investigation

Status: investigation + Sprint Board task publication only; no Java/business/OCR/template/click/navigation code changed. New card CR74 created in `docs/PACKAGE_ARCHITECTURE.md`.

Required context read:

- `AGENTS.md` from the user-provided session context.

- `superpowers:systematic-debugging` skill instructions.

Commands / evidence:

- Count scan over current `logs/dhxy-console.log`:
  - `fast path used=0`
  - `[world-map-route-memory] pending created=36`
  - `[world-map-route-memory] pending success=0`
  - `[world-map-route-memory] pending abandoned=36`
  - `reason=intent-replaced=37`
  - `confirm pending world-map route memory=0`
  - `confirm pending route memory=10`
- Config scan over `config/world_map_route_result_memory.json`:
  - `entries=36`
  - `clean=0`
  - `successCountSum=0`
  - `consecutiveSuccessPositive=0`
- Source inspection:
  - `src/main/java/com/bot/dhxy/service/NavigationService.java`
  - `src/main/java/com/bot/dhxy/window/execution/WindowTaskRunner.java`
  - `src/main/java/com/bot/dhxy/service/WorldMapRouteResultMemoryService.java`

Root cause:

- 修罗 does create world-map route-result pending memory, but it is bound to the wrong short-lived pathing intent.
- `NavigationService.submitWorldMapSearchAndClickDestination(...)` registers `worldMapRouteClick`, then `rememberPendingWorldMapRouteResultClick(...)` stores that active intent id into the pending memory.
- The outer `navigateToMap(...)` `finally` block then registers a second same-leg `navigateToMap` intent for the same `PATHING_STARTED` result, because `pathingIntentOwnedByNestedRoute` is only set for the special 灵兽村/张闻 route, not for normal world-map result clicks.
- `WindowTaskRunner.settlePendingWorldMapRouteResultMemory(...)` compares `pending.intentId` with the current active pathing intent id and correctly records `intent-replaced` when they differ. In this case, however, the replacement is an internal duplicate same-leg registration, not a real second navigation.

Concrete fresh log chain:

- `2026-06-21 17:58:36.574`: pathing intent registered as `phase=worldMapRouteClick`, `intentId=fe99b331...`, target `兰若寺`.
- `2026-06-21 17:58:36.575`: `[world-map-route-memory] pending created ... intentId=fe99b331...`.
- Immediately after: outer `navigateToMap(...)` registers `phase=navigateToMap`, `intentId=c8cceacf...`, same target `兰若寺`.
- `2026-06-21 17:58:43.837`: pending is abandoned with `reason=intent-replaced`, `pendingIntentId=fe99b331... currentIntentId=c8cceacf...`.
- Later `confirm pending route memory` logs are route-dialog / transfer-choice memory, not `WorldMapRouteResultMemoryService.recordSuccess(...)`; they do not make route-result memory clean.

Sprint Board update:

- Published CR74: `Fix world-map route-result memory intent ownership so 修罗 can promote clean route memory`.
- CR74 scope is intent ownership only:
  - either prevent the duplicate outer same-leg pathing registration after `worldMapRouteClick`, or bind pending memory to the final active intent seen by settlement;
  - preserve `intent-replaced` abandon for genuine second navigations;
  - do not change world-map OCR/click/scroll algorithms, route-dialog choice memory, 修罗 business phases, WUBEI/五倍 semantics, or the route-result clean threshold (`consecutiveSuccessCount >= 5`).

Performance goal check:

- Current performance goal is still blocked for this subpath: route-result memory never reaches clean, so 修罗 keeps paying full world-map route-result OCR/template/scroll cost.
- No improvement can be claimed yet. First acceptance step is settlement health (`pending success` appears and `intent-replaced` drops for same-leg routes). Only after five consecutive successes should `fast path used` appear and route-result OCR pressure drop.

Next action:

- Implement CR74 with a focused source-level regression test, then rerun 修罗 until `pending success`, `clean=true`, and `fast path used` are proven by fresh logs.

### Codex - 2026-06-21 / CR72 摄妖香内存信任窗口改为 50 分钟

Status: implemented; compile passed.

Context:

- User clarified that 摄妖香 memory-trust time should be 50 minutes. The 20-minute number is the
  remaining-time refill threshold after full status verification, not the cache validity window.
- `PlayerStateService` is shared by 五倍 and 修罗 leader 摄妖香 checks, so this is one global leader-task supply rule, not a 修罗-only rule.

Implementation:

- `PlayerStateService` now separates two concepts:
  - `INCENSE_MEMORY_TRUST_MS = 50 * 60 * 1000L`: if the program used 摄妖香 within the last 50 minutes, it may skip bag opening only after a lightweight status icon check proves the buff icon is present.
  - `INCENSE_REFRESH_REMAINING_MS = 20 * 60 * 1000L`: after the full status probe can read remaining time, only refill when remaining time is at or below 20 minutes.
- After memory age exceeds 50 minutes, the code no longer logs/acts as if memory is enough; it runs full status-bar verification. If remaining time is still above 20 minutes, it still skips refill.
- The status icon position is remembered as an offset inside the status rect, not a screen-absolute point.
  When the offset exists, the lightweight check first captures a small cached-position snapshot around that offset.
  If the cached snapshot misses, it falls back to the fixed window-relative status-bar crop:
  `STATUS_PANEL_X=901`, `STATUS_PANEL_Y=123`, `STATUS_PANEL_W=123`, `STATUS_PANEL_H=34`, scaled through `CoordinateHelper`.
- Reset/time audit:
  - Successful real item use still resets `lastIncenseUsedTime` to actual `System.currentTimeMillis()` and clears `nextIncenseRetryTime`.
  - Any status-bar proof that the buff icon is present clears stale failed-refill retry cooldown.
  - Full status OCR rebuilds `lastIncenseUsedTime` from remaining time, but remaining time is clamped to the internal 59-minute duration so a cyan `1 hour` read cannot push the memory timestamp into the future.

Verification:

- `mvn -q -DskipTests compile` passed after the reset/time audit.
- Suggested runtime proof: after a fresh run, look for `memory-gate-icon-present` with threshold `50`, cached-point/full-status-rect probe logs, and after 50 minutes look for `状态栏完整校验`; if full status OCR reads remaining time above 20 minutes, it should skip bag opening.

### Codex - 2026-06-21 / CR72 战后摄妖香状态栏复核卡

Status: sprint card only; no Java/business/OCR/template/click/navigation code changed.

Docs / required context read:

- `AGENTS.md`
- `docs/DHXY_CONTEXT.md`
- `docs/PACKAGE_ARCHITECTURE.md`
- `docs/ACTIVE_WORK.md`

User-approved problem / direction:

- Current 摄妖香 post-combat check can trust `lastIncenseUsedTime` too early.
- If memory says the incense was used recently and is still inside the 50-minute memory-trust window,
  `PlayerStateService.ensureSheYaoXiangActive(...)` returns before any status-bar icon proof or bag
  check.
- This makes memory time the only fact during the fresh-memory window. Pause/resume, abnormal
  combat enter/exit ordering, stale exit-signal consumption, or a bad status probe can make that
  unsafe.
- New rule: memory time is only a throttle for avoiding frequent bag opens. It cannot override the
  real status-bar fact that the 摄妖香 icon is absent.

Code path checked:

- `PlayerStateService.ensureSheYaoXiangActive(...)` currently checks
  `state.lastIncenseUsedTime > 0 && now - state.lastIncenseUsedTime < INCENSE_MEMORY_TRUST_MS`
  before calling `probeIncenseStatus(...)`.
- `AutoCombatService` calls
  `playerStateService.ensureSheYaoXiangActiveForLeaderTask(source + ":post-combat", context)` after
  post-combat recovery when leader 摄妖香 checking is enabled.
- Existing `probeIncenseStatus(...)` already captures the right-status-bar region and matches
  `images/template/status/sheyaoxiang_buff.png`, then reads cyan hour / green minute text.

Sprint Board update:

- Published CR72 in `docs/PACKAGE_ARCHITECTURE.md`.
- CR72 requirements:
  - before the 50-minute fresh-memory trust shortcut returns, do a lightweight status-bar 摄妖香 icon
    presence check;
  - icon present: keep trusting memory and do not open the bag;
  - icon absent: refill immediately and reset `lastIncenseUsedTime` to actual use time;
  - icon unknown: run the existing full status probe; if still unknown/not found, refill
    conservatively;
  - remember only the last matched offset inside the status rect, not a screen-absolute point; use it
    for a cached-position snapshot first, then fall back to the fixed window-relative status rect if
    the cached snapshot misses;
  - do not change item template, bag click algorithm, OCR thresholds, navigation, combat recovery,
    first-aid, maintenance, or 五倍/修罗 business flows.

Performance goal check:

- No new runtime performance evidence was collected in this docs-only pass.
- Expected impact is a small bounded post-combat status-icon crop when memory says 摄妖香 is fresh.
  It should be far cheaper than opening the bag and should not add runner `100ms` / task `900ms`
  churn.
- Runtime acceptance must still verify no bag spam when the icon is present and no p95/p99
  post-combat regression large enough to affect task flow.

- Incident focus: `2026-06-21 01:29:48.296-01:30:22.932`.
- End: `2026-06-21 01:30:22.932` (user pause hotkey); next heartbeat should continue after this.

Finding:

- Confirmed a P1 修罗 safety bug: the leader entered the `unknown-combat` return-home fallback while
  the same bound window was still in combat.
- `01:29:51.294`: 修罗 target tooltip click was verified by expected enter-battle dialog.
- `01:29:52.716`: `xiuluo.enterBattle` green template was clicked.
- `01:29:53.962`: task transitioned `CONFIRM_ENTER_BATTLE -> WAIT_COMBAT`.
- `01:29:54.860`: combat watcher detected combat entry for `hwnd-2D0EEE`.
- `01:29:55.338`: task-side `AutoCombatService.handleCombatTick(...)` reported
  `xiuluo-v2 auto-combat exit detected` and returned `EXIT_RECOVERED`.
- Because `enteredBattleByXiuluo()` was still false, `XiuluoTaskV2.waitCombat` entered
  `resolveUnknownCombatExit(...)`.
- `01:30:06.046`: task pressed `Alt+Q` via `quest:captureDetail:xiuluo`.
- `01:30:08.354-01:30:15.980`: task used `bag/xiuluo_return_item.png`.
- Contradiction: watcher still logged active combat for the same window at `01:30:03.591` and
  `01:30:16.330` with `branch=in-combat`.

Code path checked:

- `XiuluoTaskV2.confirmEnterBattle(...)` clicks the green enter-battle option and transitions to
  `WAIT_COMBAT`; it does not mark `enteredBattleByXiuluo` until `WAIT_COMBAT` observes
  `IN_COMBAT`.
- `XiuluoTaskV2.waitCombat(...)` currently sends `EXIT_RECOVERED && !enteredBattleByXiuluo()` to
  `resolveUnknownCombatExit(...)`.
- `resolveUnknownCombatExit(...)` can sync location, capture task detail, and use the return item
  without first proving the current bound window is not in combat.
- `BattleRadarService.checkAndSyncCombatState()` has conservative exit checks, but this incident
  still shows task-side exit consumption can contradict watcher-side active combat evidence.

Sprint Board update:

- Published CR71 in `docs/PACKAGE_ARCHITECTURE.md`: guard 修罗 unknown-combat exit against active
  combat.
- CR71 requirements:
  - before `resolveUnknownCombatExit(...)` or any return-item fallback sends input, verify the
    current bound window is not in combat;
  - if `EXIT_RECOVERED` contradicts current/fresh `IN_COMBAT`, suppress it as stale and return to
    `WAIT_COMBAT` / `WAIT_COMBAT_STATE_CHANGE`;
  - investigate/log whether the source is stale `combatExitPending`, event ordering, or per-window
    state mismatch;
  - do not change objective parsing, navigation, NPC click, enter-battle template, return-item
    algorithm, or CR61/CR62 performance behavior.

CR status / recommendation:

- CR61 and CR62 performance goals still appear active in this incident: watcher branches in combat
  skip pathing/dialog/tracker work and use `nextIntervalMs=4000`; the old 900ms combat-loop is not
  the immediate trigger.
- CR62 should not be reopened as a pure performance card; CR71 is the new correctness/safety
  follow-up because event-driven `WAIT_COMBAT` currently lacks a guard against contradictory stale
  exit recovery.
- Do not continue long 修罗 testing as an acceptance run until CR71 is implemented. Continuing only
  makes sense if the user intentionally wants more evidence around the same blocker.

Performance goal check:

- Holding: CR61/CR62 continue to reduce in-combat runner/task churn in this slice (`branch=in-combat`,
  skipped non-combat work, `nextIntervalMs=4000`).
- New blocker: the performance migration exposed/allowed a correctness race where a stale or
  contradictory `EXIT_RECOVERED` can drive heavy task-panel capture/location OCR/return-item input
  during active combat. This is not acceptable even though runner 100ms/900ms churn is reduced.
- No CR should be marked Done from this slice.

    `tryConsumePreparedWubeiDialog(... ":poll", false)` until the 15s accept timeout expired.
  - `waitForPreparedWubeiDialogReply(...)` looped forever with

    `TaskSleep.sleepOrStop(... 80ms ...)`, and re-enabled refresh after the first miss.
  - `WindowReadyEventBus` already has `currentSequence()` and `awaitNewer(... PREPARED_ACTION_READY
    ...)` from earlier CR41+ framework work, so CR59 can use that instead of adding new bus APIs.

CR59 implementation intent:

- Replace same-window prepared-dialog polling with event wake:
  - consume once on entry;
  - register/refresh interest once when requested;
  - capture `currentSequence()` immediately before waiting;
  - wake only on newer `PREPARED_ACTION_READY`;
  - after a matching event, consume once;
  - ignore mismatched operation/target events and continue until the existing business deadline.
- Preserve accept-task's existing 15s foreground business timeout.
- Preserve 白龙马/probe targetReady enter-battle's existing 300s timeout and 5s timeout recheck.
- Do not change 白龙马 probe result meanings, 普通怪/黄袍 first-battle terminal/timeout rules,
  黄袍续战 hot-path click rules, OCR/template thresholds, click coordinates, navigation, direct
  combat, tooltip, or Alt+A policy.

Implementation summary:

- `WubeiTask.waitForPreparedWubeiDialog(...)` no longer sleeps up to 80ms and retries consume inside
  the accept-task foreground timeout.
  - It captures the ready-event sequence before the entry consume.
  - It consumes once on entry, refreshing interest only for that one entry consume when requested.
  - It waits for newer current-window `PREPARED_ACTION_READY` events until the existing 15s accept
    business timeout expires.
  - It ignores mismatched prepared operations and consumes once after each matching ready event.
- `WubeiTask.waitForPreparedWubeiDialogReply(...)` no longer loops through
  `TaskSleep(80ms) -> consume`.
  - It performs one entry consume / optional interest refresh.
  - It waits on `PREPARED_ACTION_READY` and consumes once per matching event.
  - It does not re-register interest on every miss.
  - For `WUBEI_ENTER_BATTLE`, the existing `PROBE_ENTER_BATTLE_EVENT_RECHECK_MS = 5000ms` is used
    only as the maximum blocking slice for stop / probe 300s timeout checks, not as a prepared-action
    poll.
- Deleted `WUBEI_PREPARED_DIALOG_POLL_MS` from `WubeiTask`.
- Did not change OCR/template thresholds, click coordinates, navigation, direct-combat, tooltip,
  Alt+A, 白龙马 probe result branching, 普通/黄袍 first-battle terminal/timeout rules, or 黄袍续战
  hot-path click strategy.

  - 黄袍续战 still registers `WUBEI_ENTER_BATTLE interest` before continuation click and stays on the
    hot path; CR59 did not change cached tracker click behavior.

Status: Task published / no Java code changed.

Files read:

- `AGENTS.md`
- `docs/DHXY_CONTEXT.md`

- `docs/ACTIVE_WORK.md`
- `docs/业务逻辑.md`
- `src/main/java/com/bot/dhxy/service/dialog/DialogOperation.java`

Independent findings:

- Current `WindowTaskRunner` has a single hot dialog prepare interval and can keep observer ticks hot
  when a prepared action exists.
- Existing prepared actions can be revalidated in watcher ticks through fingerprint comparison,
  refreshing `lastVerifiedAtMs` and republishing READY. This turns the `2500ms/3000ms` freshness
  fence into background "keepalive" and creates CPU/log pressure.
- The fix must be framework/performance plumbing only: do not change task business decisions,
  template thresholds, OCR fallback, click coordinates, route order, probe branching, or 黄袍/普通/
  白龙马/修罗 phase behavior.

Sprint board changes:

- Added CR58 row to `docs/PACKAGE_ARCHITECTURE.md`.
- Added detailed `Card CR58: Prepared action READY 后停止后台 100ms fingerprint 续命`.

CR58 fixed implementation contract:

- Before prepared:
  - `WUBEI_ENTER_BATTLE`: `100ms`;
  - `WUBEI_PROBE_STORY`: `200ms`;
  - `ROUTE_TRANSFER`: `1000ms`;
  - `TASK_TRACKER_PATHING`: `1000ms`;
  - every other `DialogOperation`: `500ms`.
- After prepared:
  - same action must not keep watcher at `100ms`;
  - same action must not be background fingerprint-revalidated just to refresh `lastVerifiedAtMs`;
  - same action must not repeatedly publish `PREPARED_ACTION_READY`.
- Consume:
  - every `clickRequired=true` action must perform validation-rect fingerprint verification
    immediately before atomic consume/click;
  - validation failure clears the same action and does not click old coordinates;
  - every `clickRequired=false` business signal skips fingerprint validation and must not be rejected
    solely because `lastVerifiedAtMs` is older than the click-action freshness window.

Performance goal check:

- No new runtime evidence in this documentation-only turn.
- CR58 is designed to reduce repeated `prepared-action-verified`, duplicate READY publishes, and
  observer `100ms` pressure after an action is already prepared, while preserving `prepared -> consume`
  and enter-battle/route latency through consume-time validation.

Testing recommendation:

- Do not restart just for this documentation-only card.
- After CR58 is implemented, restart and run fresh 五倍/黄袍/白龙马/修罗 slices to prove reduced
  prepared-ready log pressure and no p95/p99 prepared-action latency regression.

### Codex - 2026-06-20 / CR57 runner dialog snapshot sharing task

Status: Source implemented / Review / fresh runtime validation pending.

User request:

- Create a sprint task for reducing duplicate Runner dialog screenshots/detects in one watcher tick.
- The agreed direction is: same-tick dialog attention / task prepare / route prepare / remembered
  route / final attention should reuse one fresh ephemeral dialog detection instead of taking
  multiple screenshots of the same visible dialog.

Evidence used:

- `WindowTaskRunner.runCombatWatcherLoop(...)` can call dialog attention, task dialog preparation,
  route preparation, and final attention in the same observer tick.
- `DialogService.detectDialogSnapshotDirect(...)` captures the dialog region, and current prepare
  paths can recapture independently:
  - white/story prepare through `prepareWhiteStoryTemplateOrAbsent(...)`;
  - green option template prepare through `prepareGreenTemplateOption(...)`;
  - route keyword prepare through `prepareRouteKeywordOption(...)`;
  - remembered route prepare through `prepareRememberedChoiceOption(...)`.
- Recent logs showed duplicated dialog work, for example `2026-06-20 01:20:50` where task attention
  detected `OPTION`, then route prepare separately spent `detectMs=700 ocrMs=3691 totalMs=4391`,
  pushing the same observer tick to `attentionTotalMs=6111`.

Sprint board changes:

- Added CR57 row in `docs/PACKAGE_ARCHITECTURE.md`.
- Added detailed `Card CR57: Runner dialog branches reuse one per-tick DialogDetection`.

Important boundaries written into CR57:

- This is a framework/performance card, not a business-logic rewrite.
- Implementing agent must read `docs/业务逻辑.md` before and after editing and record that 白龙马、
  普通怪、黄袍怪、修罗业务逻辑 are still preserved.
- Do not share/merge minimap pathing screenshots, battle radar screenshots, tracker panel parsing,
  NPC click matching, or world-map route matching into this dialog snapshot sharing card.
- Do not store long-lived `BufferedImage` in `WindowDialogSnapshot` or `WindowRuntimeContext`.
- Do not change OCR/template thresholds, click coordinates, navigation, prepared action semantics, or
  task fallback order.

Implementation summary:

- `DialogService` now exposes `detectDialogSnapshotNoFocus(...)` so the runner can capture a
  full `DialogDetection` once per watcher tick instead of only reading `DialogType`.
- `DialogService` route keyword, remembered route/choice, green-template prepare, and white-story
  prepare paths now accept an optional supplied `DialogDetection`.
  - A supplied detection is reused only when it has an image/rect and the required dialog type
    matches.
  - Incompatible detections are logged and fall back to the existing capture/detect path.
  - `WUBEI_PROBE_STORY` can reuse a supplied `NONE` detection only when story-absent output is
    explicitly allowed by the current interest.
- `WindowDialogPreparationProvider` now has a default overload that accepts a supplied detection.
  Existing providers can ignore it; `WubeiDialogPreparationProvider` uses it for accept task,
  enter-battle, and probe story preparation.
- `WindowTaskRunner` now creates one local `TickDialogProbe` per watcher tick and passes it through:
  - task attention;
  - route/remembered route preparation;
  - task dialog-interest preparation;
  - final task attention.
  The probe is local to one loop iteration and never stores `BufferedImage` in
  `WindowDialogSnapshot` or `WindowRuntimeContext`.
- No minimap/pathing, battle radar, tracker panel parsing, NPC click, world-map route matching,
  OCR/template thresholds, click coordinates, navigation semantics, prepared-action consume
  semantics, or task fallback order were changed for CR57.

Business logic reread after editing:

- `docs/业务逻辑.md` was reread after implementation.
- Preserved business rules:
  - 白龙马 CR39/CR40/CR53 probe and targetReady rules are unchanged; CR57 only supplies the same
    already-captured dialog image to the existing provider.
  - 普通怪 CR41-CR45 runner/prepared-action rules are unchanged; task code still consumes only
    prepared actions or pathing events.

### 唐德 - 2026-06-19 / 五环第二轮鞋需求误判修复

Status: Java code changed / compile passed.

Request:

- User observed window `67555` with 五环 configured for 2 runs: first run bought 2 shoes, second run
  should only need the remaining 1 shoe, but the task re-entered the buy-shoe flow.

Root cause:

- `FiveRingTaskV2.prepare(...)` was using the configured total run count as the required shoe count
  on every round.
- With `wuhuanMaxRuns=2`, round 2 still logged `requiredShoes=2`; a remaining single shoe was
  therefore treated as insufficient.

Change:

- `FiveRingTaskV2` now calculates shoe requirement from remaining runs:
  - round 1 of 2 requires 2 shoes;
  - round 2 of 2 requires 1 shoe;
  - unlimited/legacy non-positive run count requires only the current-run shoe.
- `BUY_SHOES` fallback now uses the same remaining-run calculation when no explicit missing count is
  carried in `FiveRingPhaseContext`.

Verification:

- `mvn -q -DskipTests compile` passed.

  `wubei:RESOLVE_AFTER_PATHING`, `consumePrepared result=absent`, and
  `dialog.interest.update`.
  - Improved, but not fully solved.
  - Earlier sprint evidence recorded much worse churn, for example CR25 had
    `WAIT_BATTLE_FINISH same=315/315` in one short slice and older baseline notes had
    `task.turn.handoff=2579`, `task.turn.handoff.sameAsPrevious=2575`.
  - This run is lower overall: `task.turn.handoff=170`, `sameAsPrevious=123`,
    top analyzer bucket `WAIT_BATTLE_FINISH same=94/94`.
  - Remaining issue: `consumePrepared.absent=2138` and `dialog.interest.update=1776` are still high
    because 白龙马 CR53 creates a concentrated absent loop.

- Original problem 2: timeout-heavy parked waits, especially `WAIT_BATTLE_FINISH` / combat waits,
  should wake by event instead of mostly by fallback timeout.
  - Clearly improved in this window.
  - CR25 baseline examples: `wubei.wait.parkFinished=350`, `wakeEvent=19`,

  - This run: `wubei.wait.parkFinished=89`, `wakeEvent=89`, `wakeTimeout=0`;
    `window.ready.await.event=91`, `window.ready.await.timeout=0`.
  - Verdict: timeout-heavy wait problem is materially improved for the checked 五倍 window.

- Original problem 3: `dialog.interest.update` / `consumePrepared result=absent` should not refresh
  and log the same no-result state every 80-100ms when nothing changed.
  - Not fully improved.
  - 普通怪/黄袍 first-battle no longer show the old fixed 10s delayed-interest pattern, but 白龙马
    targetReady 后 still loops `smart-combat-target:* result=absent` about 1689 times.
  - Verdict: global CPU/log pressure target fails until CR53 is fixed.

- Original problem 4: latency preservation rule. CPU/log pressure can decrease only if critical
  ready-to-click, prepared-dialog, pathing-handoff, and combat-follow-up latency does not regress.
  - Mixed / not fully proven.
  - Good: prepared consumption still works after map-gate opening; analyzer reported
    `preparedAgeMs p95=337ms`.
  - Risk: analyzer reported `preparedAgeMs p99=1620ms`, which is higher than the older CR25 healthy
    prepared-dialog reference (`preparedAgeMs p99=181ms max=545ms`). Because the raw log window has
    since rolled/been overwritten, this p99 cannot be decomposed further from the current file.
  - Verdict: p95 is acceptable, but p99 latency preservation is not proven cleanly. Do not mark the

- Original problem 5: `WAIT_BATTLE_FINISH combat still running` should not be the dominant spam,
  and combat follow-up should use `COMBAT_STATE_CHANGED` / event wake rather than 400ms self-poll.
  - Improved.
  - Current run has `wakeTimeout=0` for 五倍 waits and much lower `WAIT_BATTLE_FINISH` same-window
    count than the CR25 baselines.
  - Remaining same-window entries are mostly battle-state waiting, not timeout-heavy fallback churn.

- Original problem 6: pathing/dialog waits should wake from Runner/provider facts, not by repeated
  foreground polling or coarse safety timeouts.
  - Improved for ordinary/黄袍 first-battle: CR52 target-map gate opened 22 times and old
    `normal-enter-battle-delayed` was 0.
  - Still missing proof for two acceptance paths: ordinary `PATHING_TERMINAL -> same-green re-click`
    and `PRE_BATTLE_TIMEOUT`.

- Overall corrected verdict:
  - The architecture-level performance target is partially improved, not achieved.
  - Improved: event wake ratio, timeout-heavy combat/pathing waits, CR51 lifecycle, CR52 target-map
    gate, 黄袍续战 hot path.

### Codex - 2026-06-19 / CR47 third-view review after interest-lifetime clarification

Status: Blocked / business-lifetime mismatch found / no business code changed by reviewer.

Scope:

- User asked to review CR47 again.
- Rechecked against `docs/业务逻辑.md` 黄袍怪 points 20-24 and the clarified rule from the user:
  `WUBEI_ENTER_BATTLE` interest should be cleared by entering battle / phase reset / task reset, not by
  a short automatic expiry while the leader is still waiting for Runner.

Finding:

- CR47 correctly moved 黄袍 continuation `WUBEI_ENTER_BATTLE` interest before the physical
  `chained-combat-*` green click, and it still avoids ordinary pathing intent for continuation.
- But the implementation still calls the generic `registerWubeiDialogInterest(...)`, which sets
  `expiresAtMs = now + WUBEI_DIALOG_INTEREST_TTL_MS` (`15_000ms`).
- During the continuation `ENTER_BATTLE` bounded retry, `tickEnterBattle(...)` only registers the
  phase-start interest when `enterBattleStartedAt <= 0`, and `continueChainedEnterBattleInPhase(...)`
  only sleeps/retries the same phase; it does not keep the continuation interest alive.
- Therefore a 黄袍 continuation can still lose `WUBEI_ENTER_BATTLE` authorization after about 15s
  while it is still in the valid continuation入战 phase. Runner would then see `OPTION` as visible
  attention/no operation instead of preparing the allowed `WUBEI_ENTER_BATTLE` action. This is the
  same class of business mismatch as the 15:59 黄袍 first-battle interest expiry, just in CR47's
  post-first-battle hot path.

Evidence:

- `src/main/java/com/bot/dhxy/task/wubei/WubeiTask.java:2245` registers pre-click continuation
  interest through `registerWubeiDialogInterest(...)`.
- `src/main/java/com/bot/dhxy/task/wubei/WubeiTask.java:1854` sets the generic interest expiry to
  `System.currentTimeMillis() + WUBEI_DIALOG_INTEREST_TTL_MS`.
- `src/main/java/com/bot/dhxy/task/wubei/WubeiTask.java:187` defines that TTL as `15_000L`.
- `src/main/java/com/bot/dhxy/task/wubei/WubeiTask.java:2910-2920` registers phase-start interest
  only once per enter-battle runtime.
- `src/main/java/com/bot/dhxy/task/wubei/WubeiTask.java:3036-3044` continuation retry only sleeps
  and retries the same phase; it does not refresh or phase-own the interest.

Required fix for CR47:

- Give 黄袍 continuation `WUBEI_ENTER_BATTLE` interest a phase-owned lifetime: valid from before the
  `chained-combat-*` click until prepared action is consumed and `WAIT_BATTLE_FINISH` starts, or
  until continuation fails/resets/stops.
- Do not let the 15s generic TTL decide continuation business behavior.
- Clear the continuation interest explicitly on successful prepared consumption / entering
  `WAIT_BATTLE_FINISH`, click failure, task reset, or failure path.
- Fresh validation should show no `window.dialog.interest.clear ... reason=expired` for
  `wubei:chained-enter-battle-before-click:*` while the continuation `ENTER_BATTLE` phase is still
  active.
